test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All students are good

Rachel is a student.

Some good are honest.

**Conclusions:**

I. Rachel is honest

II. Some honest are good

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

All students are good

Rachel is a student.

Some good are honest.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc33a24093d0b84a22f52ef812a78b8231cd2d3a91d8db2f6829cfc284aef20b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Rachel is honest - False (Because, No definite relation given between Rachel and honest, so it can be possible only).

II. Some honest are good - True (Because, Some good are honest also gives that Some honest are good).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
